newsitem.title: USA: Forest Oil producing High Island find.
newsitem.headline: Forest Oil producing High Island find.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said Tuesday its High Island Block A-274 A-1 discovery well in the Gulf of Mexico is now producing at about 10 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
The well is producing from the deeper of two gas bearing intervals from perforations between 6,000 feet and 6,010 feet through a 34/64 inch choke at 1,290 pounds per square flowing tubing pressure.
The discovery, located offshore Texas, was first announced in January 1996. Production is flowing through a mobile offshore production unit.
Forest Oil operates the well with a 100 percent working interest. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
